name: Halter Throw
description: Throw a halter of qi over a foe's head and shoulders and draw it tight.

name: Yoke Brace
description: Set a yoke of qi across both shoulders to bear a blow that would drive the user down.

name: Binder's Ear
description: Listen along a line for the hum that tells whether the foe at the end is afraid.

name: Bridle Hold
description: Bridle a charging foe with a loop at the jaw and turn the foe's course by the reins.

name: Harness Share
description: Harness two allies side by side so their strength pulls as one.

name: Cord Wrench
description: Wrench a cord tied to a foe's weapon hand until the foe's grip opens.

name: Great Halter
description: Close a halter of great weight round a powerful foe and lead the foe where the user wills.

name: Chain Counter
description: Wrap a blow in a chain of qi and return its full force along the chain to the striker.

name: Binding Verdict
description: Close a grand binding on one chosen foe that locks body and qi together until the binder lets go.

name: Forked Cord
description: Cast a cord from each of the user's hands so that both of a foe's arms are caught.

name: Pairing Step
description: Tie to an ally with a short line and step as one body toward a foe.

name: Twinned Ward
description: Raise a ward of qi on each side so a blow from either flank is caught.

name: Judge's Weigh
description: Weigh the pull of two bound beings to see which is truly the stronger.

name: Seconded Strain
description: Pass part of an ally's wounds across a bond so a second body carries them.

name: Dual Lock
description: Lock a foe's two hands apart with two seals so no joined technique can form.

name: Answering Cord
description: Answer a foe's cast cord with the user's own and knot the two together.

name: Tandem Fetters
description: Hold two foes in fetters tied to each other so neither can move without the other.

name: Duet Shackle
description: Shackle two limbs of a foe in one motion and wrench them in opposite directions.

name: Dual Binding
description: Close a binding from two directions at once and seal the foe's technique at both ends.

name: Claw Cord
description: Fling a clawed cord at a foe's cloak and tear the foe off balance.

name: High Perch
description: Anchor to a high point by a line and guard from above where blows come weaker.

name: Hawk Glance
description: Follow a thread from the hand across a crowd to find which person is tied to which.

name: Soaring Tether
description: Fire a tether to a high point and soar along it in a long rising leap.

name: Stooping Cord
description: Stoop a cord down on a foe from above and take the foe by the neck and arms.

name: Talon Release
description: Pluck a binding from an ally with the careful hook of a talon and leave the flesh unharmed.

name: Aerial Net
description: Throw a net of tethers high over a field and drop it on every foe beneath.

name: Stooping Dive
description: Dive along a tether from a height and drive a cord-wrapped strike through a guard.

name: Far Seizure
description: Seize a foe across a great distance by a bond that needs no visible line.

name: Silt Knot
description: Knot heavy qi round a foe's boots until each step sinks as if through silt.

name: Stilled Shield
description: Still a patch of moving qi into a guard that catches a blow like a held pool.

name: Under Sense
description: Feel the shape of the bonds lying beneath a clash's moving surface.

name: Held Current
description: Tie a flow of enemy qi into a held current that cannot leave the foe's body.

name: Channel Bind
description: Bind a foe's qi channels with threads that follow the current of breath.

name: Eddy Wrench
description: Spin an eddy of qi round a foe's technique and drag it off its line.

name: Stilled Flow
description: Hold a whole rush of moving foes motionless in one stilled flow of bonds.

name: Banked Surge
description: Bank an incoming surge of force along a tether and loose it back as a wave.

name: Held Stream
description: Fix a whole stream of force and bodies in place with a single bond until the binder releases it.

name: Master Noose
description: Throw a noose that finds a moving foe's neck and seats itself in one cast.

name: Fetter Brace
description: Brace the arms with fetters of qi that turn a strike back toward the striker's own wrist.

name: Paired Stride
description: Stride along two tethers cast in turn so the body leaps without touching ground.

name: Master's Feel
description: Feel every tether touching the user and trace each to its holder.

name: Pair Pulse
description: Strike down both ends of a paired cord at once to jolt two foes together.

name: Mastered Snare
description: Draw a snare so subtle that the foe feels it only after the limb is held.

name: Duo Wrench
description: Wrench two paired cords in opposite ways to wreck the footing of both foes.

name: Fetter Gift
description: Lend an ally the user's own fetters so the ally can hold a foe as the master does.

name: Grand Fetters
description: Lock a strong foe's limbs in fetters that the foe's own struggle only tightens.

name: Counter Seizure
description: Catch an attacking limb in a fetter and turn the attacker's momentum against its owner.

name: Paired Subjugation
description: Subject two foes to a bond that drains their strength into each other until both fall still.

name: Wind Snare
description: Whip a snare of qi on the wind and close it over a foe's arm.

name: Bearing Anchor
description: Tie the stance to an inner bearing so no gust of force can turn the user.

name: Vowed Stride
description: Step along a line sworn to a distant mark and arrive at it true.

name: Oath Cinch
description: Cinch a foe with a line sworn to hold until the foe puts down the weapon.

name: Honest Strain
description: Bind an ally to the user's word so the ally's courage cannot waver while the vow holds.

name: Wind Loop
description: Loop a gust round a foe's casting arm and drag the cast aside.

name: Sworn Hawser
description: Stretch a great sworn line across a front of foes and hold all of them behind it.

name: Sworn Lashing
description: Lash sworn cords out on the wind to take every foe the gust touches.

name: Unwalled Binding
description: Cast a binding over a wide front with nothing to shelter behind and hold every foe within it.

name: Pledge Hitch
description: Hitch a foe's weapon arm to the user's pledge so the arm slows.

name: Vow Ward
description: Raise a guard of qi bound to a spoken oath that holds against strikes.

name: Truth Thread
description: Send a thread to a speaker and feel whether the speaker means the words.

name: Sworn Draw
description: Draw along a sworn tether to an ally in need.

name: Tied Vow
description: Bind a vow to an ally's task so strength comes to it as the vow is kept.

name: Oath Wrench
description: Wrench the oath behind a foe's technique so the technique no longer holds together.

name: Vow Release
description: Release an ally from a forced oath laid by a foe's binding.

name: Oath Chain
description: Link a foe with an oath chain whose weight grows with every lie the foe tells.

name: Vow Counter
description: Return the harm of a broken vow upon the foe who broke it.

name: Vow Binding
description: Bind a foe to a vow so completely that the foe's blows and words alike are held.

name: Edge Tie
description: Tie a foe's lead foot with a quick line at the limit of its reach.

name: Unbent Brace
description: Brace against a charge with a stance that bends but does not give.

name: Bearing Reach
description: Take a bearing on a far mark and stride along it.

name: Holding Bearing
description: Hold a bearing for allies so their stances keep to one line.

name: Straight Cord
description: Run an unbent cord from user to foe and keep it level against any pull.

name: Veer Break
description: Break a foe's bearing with a sharp tug so the foe loses all sense of direction.

name: Unsevered Cord
description: Hold a foe on a line that cannot be cut while the user's stance stays whole.

name: Open Reach
description: Throw bonds across open ground in every direction and hold all foes they touch.

name: Bearing Seizure
description: Seize a foe by the very bearing the foe walks on and hold the foe motionless.

name: Open Hold
description: Close an open hand on a foe's wrist with a grip of qi that does not bruise.

name: Offered Palm
description: Offer an open palm that stops a blow with a sworn gentleness.

name: Hand Sense
description: Take a hand to read the oath that rests in the other person's heart.

name: Held Hand
description: Hold an ally's hand and share steadiness across the bond.

name: Soft Fetter
description: Close a soft fetter on a foe that holds without pain and without escape.

name: Open Cleansing
description: Open a path through an ally's binding with a palm and lift the binding clear.

name: Open-Handed Bond
description: Bond with a gathering of allies hand to hand so each shares the others' guards.

name: Truce Binding
description: Bind a circle of foes to a truce that holds while the binder's hand stays open.

name: Gentle Subjugation
description: Quiet a field of foes with a bond so soft they do not feel the hold until they cannot rise.

name: Chain Cast
description: Cast a chain of qi link by link round a foe's torso.

name: Chain Guard
description: Drape chain links across the body to turn aside a strike.

name: Link Sense
description: Count the links of a chain to read how many oaths bind its holder.

name: Chain Walk
description: Walk along a taut chain of qi over any gap.

name: Long Chain
description: Let out a very long chain and keep it taut at any distance.

name: Sworn Link
description: Link allies by sworn links so each can call strength from the others.

name: Link Break
description: Break a single link in a foe's chain of technique and watch the rest fall.

name: Heavy Chain
description: Lay a heavy chain round a strong foe that no strength alone can break.

name: Chain Return
description: Catch a blow in a chain link and bind the striker with the rest.

name: Oathbound Chain
description: Close a chain sworn to the binder's word round a foe and let the weight of the oath do the holding.
